```python
import datetime, sys
def log_entry(project, skill, tokens_in, tokens_out, status, duration, notes):
    ts = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
    row = f"| {ts} | {project} | {skill} | {tokens_in} | {tokens_out} | {status} | {duration:.1f} | {notes} |"

```

tasks.title: Implement token tracking daily aggregation
tasks.description: Create the token metrics aggregation system (§6.2) with daily roll-up JSON files.
tasks.details:
Create `scripts/aggregate_tokens.py` (invoked by cron or end-of-day):
```python
import json, datetime, glob
from collections import defaultdict

def aggregate_daily():
    today = datetime.date.today().isoformat()
    tokens = defaultdict(lambda: {"in": 0, "out": 0})
    # Parse global-pipeline.log.md, extract tokens_in/out per project for today
    with open("~/.kira-hq/global-pipeline.log.md") as f:
        for line in f:
            if today in line:
                parts = line.split("|")
                project = parts[2].strip()
                tokens[project]["in"] += int(parts[4].strip())
                tokens[project]["out"] += int(parts[5].strip())
    with open(f"~/.kira-hq/metrics/tokens-{today}.json", "w") as out:
        json.dump(dict(tokens), out, indent=2)
```
Schedule via cron at 23:59 daily.

tasks.title: Implement cron failure handling and retry logic
tasks.description: Build the 2-tier retry system (§6.3) with incident logging and Telegram alerts (stub for now, real Telegram in Module 4).
tasks.details:
Create `scripts/run_skill_with_retry.sh`:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
PROJECT=$1
SKILL=$2
shift 2

# First attempt
$SKILL "$@" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/skill.log
if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ]; then
  python scripts/log_pipeline.py $PROJECT $SKILL 0 0 ok $(date +%s) 'success'
  exit 0
fi

# Retry after 60s
sleep 60
$SKILL "$@" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/skill.log
if [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ]; then
  python scripts/log_pipeline.py $PROJECT $SKILL 0 0 ok $(date +%s) 'retry-success'
  exit 0
fi

# Both failed → create incident
TS=$(date +"%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
INCIDENT=~/.kira-hq/incidents/${TS}-${PROJECT}.md
echo "# Incident: $PROJECT / $SKILL" > $INCIDENT
echo "## Timestamp: $(date)" >> $INCIDENT
tail -50 /tmp/skill.log >> $INCIDENT
python scripts/log_pipeline.py $PROJECT $SKILL 0 0 fail $(date +%s) "failed-twice-see-$TS"
python scripts/telegram_alert.py "🔴 $PROJECT/$SKILL failed twice. See incident $TS."  # stub for now
python scripts/mark_stale.py $PROJECT
exit 1
```
Create `scripts/mark_stale.py` (sets `status: stale` in projects.yaml). Create `scripts/telegram_alert.py` stub (prints to stdout, real impl in task 25).

tasks.title: Implement daily backup snapshots with rsync
tasks.description: Create the snapshot script (§6.7) with rsync hardlink deduplication and 7-day rolling window.
tasks.details:
Create `scripts/snapshot.sh`:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
TODAY=$(date +%F)
YESTERDAY=$(date -d "yesterday" +%F 2>/dev/null || date -v-1d +%F)  # macOS compat
SNAPDIR=~/.kira-hq/snapshots/$TODAY
mkdir -p $SNAPDIR

# Rsync with hardlinks to yesterday's snapshot
if [ -d ~/.kira-hq/snapshots/$YESTERDAY ]; then
  rsync -a --link-dest=~/.kira-hq/snapshots/$YESTERDAY ~/Projects/*/.taskmaster/ $SNAPDIR/
else
  rsync -a ~/Projects/*/.taskmaster/ $SNAPDIR/
fi

# Delete snapshots >7 days old
find ~/.kira-hq/snapshots/ -maxdepth 1 -type d -mtime +7 -exec rm -rf {} \;
echo "Snapshot $TODAY complete" | tee -a ~/.kira-hq/snapshots/snapshot.log
```

tasks.title: Implement ADR convention and index renderer
tasks.description: Create the ADR template (§6.8) and script to generate per-project and global ADR indexes.
tasks.details:
Already created `templates/ADR.md` in task 1. Now create `scripts/render_adr_index.py`:
```python
import os, glob, yaml

def render_project_adr_index(project_path):
    adr_dir = f"{project_path}/docs/ADR"
    if not os.path.exists(adr_dir): return
    adrs = sorted(glob.glob(f"{adr_dir}/*.md"))
    with open(f"{adr_dir}/INDEX.md", "w") as idx:
        idx.write("# ADR Index\n\n")
        for adr in adrs:
            if "INDEX" in adr: continue
            name = os.path.basename(adr)
            idx.write(f"- [{name}](./{name})\n")

def render_global_adr_index():
    with open("~/.kira-hq/projects.yaml") as f:
        projects = yaml.safe_load(f)["projects"]
    with open("~/.kira-hq/global-adrs.md", "w") as g:
        g.write("# Global ADR Index\n\n")
        for p in projects:
            adr_dir = f"{p['path']}/docs/ADR"
            if os.path.exists(adr_dir):
                g.write(f"## {p['name']}\n")
                adrs = sorted(glob.glob(f"{adr_dir}/*.md"))[:5]  # last 5
                for adr in adrs:
                    if "INDEX" in adr: continue
                    g.write(f"- {os.path.basename(adr)}\n")
```
Invoke from Module 1 renderer.

tasks.title: Implement kira-hq add-project CLI command
tasks.description: Build the add-project tool (§6.9) that validates repos, prompts for config, updates projects.yaml, and symlinks skills.
tasks.details:
Create `scripts/add_project.py` (CLI wrapper callable as `kira-hq add-project <path>`):
```python
import os, sys, yaml, subprocess
from datetime import date

def add_project(path):
    path = os.path.expanduser(path)
    if not os.path.exists(path): raise ValueError("Path does not exist")
    if not os.path.exists(f"{path}/.git"): raise ValueError("Not a git repo")
    if not os.path.exists(f"{path}/.taskmaster"):
        if input("No .taskmaster/ found. Run task-master init? [y/N] ").lower() == 'y':
            subprocess.run(["task-master", "init"], cwd=path, check=True)
    if not os.path.exists(f"{path}/prd/master-prd.md"): print("⚠️  No PRD found")
    
    name = os.path.basename(path)
    with open("~/.kira-hq/projects.yaml") as f: projects_yaml = yaml.safe_load(f)
    if any(p["name"] == name for p in projects_yaml["projects"]): raise ValueError("Name already exists")
    
    priority = input("Priority [high/medium/low]: ") or "medium"
    cron = input("Cron schedule (e.g. '0 */2 * * *'): ") or "0 */2 * * *"
    budget = int(input("Budget tokens/month [500000]: ") or 500000)
    skills = input("Skills to enable (comma-separated): ").split(",")
    
    projects_yaml["projects"].append({
        "name": name, "path": path, "status": "active", "priority": priority,
        "cron": cron, "added_at": date.today().isoformat(),
        "skills": [s.strip() for s in skills if s.strip()],
        "budget_tokens_monthly": budget, "budget_tokens_per_run": budget//10,
        "notes": ""
    })
    with open("~/.kira-hq/projects.yaml", "w") as f: yaml.dump(projects_yaml, f)
    
    # Symlink skills
    os.makedirs(f"{path}/.claude/skills", exist_ok=True)
    for skill in skills:
        if skill.strip():
            os.symlink(f"~/.kira-hq/skills-shared/{skill.strip()}", f"{path}/.claude/skills/{skill.strip()}")
    
    # Create .env skeleton
    with open(f"{path}/.env", "w") as env: env.write("# Project-specific secrets\n")
    os.chmod(f"{path}/.env", 0o600)
    
    print(f"✅ Project '{name}' added. Run kira-hq-render-kanban to generate first kanban.")
```
Create `scripts/archive_project.py` (sets status: archived, stops cron).

tasks.title: Implement needs-attention algorithm and markdown output
tasks.description: Build the needs-attention logic (§6.10) that scans projects for blocked tasks, stale high-priority tasks, budget overruns, and failed crons.
tasks.details:
Create `scripts/generate_needs_attention.py`:
```python
import yaml, json, subprocess, datetime
from collections import defaultdict

def needs_attention():
    with open("~/.kira-hq/projects.yaml") as f: projects = yaml.safe_load(f)["projects"]
    blocked, stale, failed_crons, over_budget = [], [], [], []
    
    for p in projects:
        if p["status"] != "active": continue
        tasks_json = subprocess.run(["task-master", "list", "--json"], cwd=p["path"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
        tasks = json.loads(tasks_json)
        
        for t in tasks:
            # Blocked >48h
            if t.get("status") == "blocked":
                updated = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(t.get("updated_at", datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()))
                if (datetime.datetime.now() - updated).total_seconds() > 48*3600:
                    blocked.append(f"{p['name']}/T-{t['id']} \"{t['title']}\" — {int((datetime.datetime.now()-updated).total_seconds()/3600)}h")
            # High-prio stale >72h
            if t.get("priority") == "high" and t.get("status") == "pending":
                updated = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(t.get("updated_at", datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()))
                if (datetime.datetime.now() - updated).total_seconds() > 72*3600:
                    stale.append(f"{p['name']}/T-{t['id']} \"{t['title']}\"")
        
        # Check failed crons in last 24h from pipeline.log
        # Check token budget (sum last 30d from metrics/)
    
    with open("~/.kira-hq/needs-attention.md", "w") as out:
        out.write(f"# Needs Attention — {datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()}\n\n")
        out.write(f"## 🔴 Blocked >48h ({len(blocked)})\n")
        for b in blocked: out.write(f"- {b}\n")
        out.write(f"\n## 🟠 High-prio stale >72h ({len(stale)})\n")
        for s in stale: out.write(f"- {s}\n")
        # Add failed crons, budget sections similarly
```
Invoked by Module 1 renderer and exposed via Module 2 API.

tasks.title: Module 1: Generate global kanban and needs-attention markdown
tasks.description: Extend renderer to produce global-kanban.md (cross-project aggregate) and needs-attention.md (invoking task 11's algorithm).
tasks.details:
Extend `scripts/render_kanban.py`:
```python
def render_global_kanban(projects):
    all_tasks = []
    for p in [p for p in projects if p["status"] == "active"]:
        tasks_json = subprocess.run(["task-master", "list", "--json"], cwd=p["path"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
        tasks = json.loads(tasks_json)
        for t in tasks:
            t["project"] = p["name"]
            all_tasks.append(t)
    
    with open("~/.kira-hq/global-kanban.md", "w") as gk:
        gk.write("# Global Kanban (All Projects)\n\n")
        # Group by status, then by project
        by_status = defaultdict(list)
        for t in all_tasks:
            by_status[t.get("status", "pending")].append(t)
        for status, tasks in sorted(by_status.items()):
            gk.write(f"## {status.title()} ({len(tasks)})\n")
            for t in tasks:
                gk.write(f"- **{t['project']}/T-{t['id']}** {t['title']}\n")
            gk.write("\n")

# In main():
render_global_kanban(projects)
subprocess.run(["python", "scripts/generate_needs_attention.py"], check=True)
```
Also invoke ADR index renderer (task 9).

```python
router = APIRouter(prefix="/projects", tags=["projects"])

@router.get("")
def list_projects():
    with open(Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "projects.yaml") as f:
        projects = yaml.safe_load(f)["projects"]
    result = []
    for p in projects:
        tasks_json = subprocess.run(
            ["task-master", "list", "--json"],
            cwd=p["path"], capture_output=True, text=True
        ).stdout
        tasks = json.loads(tasks_json) if tasks_json else []
        result.append({
            "name": p["name"],
            "status": p["status"],
            "priority": p["priority"],
            "task_count": len(tasks),
            "pending": len([t for t in tasks if t.get("status") == "pending"]),
            "in_progress": len([t for t in tasks if t.get("status") == "in-progress"]),
            "blocked": len([t for t in tasks if t.get("status") == "blocked"]),
        })
    return result
```

```python
from fastapi import APIRouter
import subprocess, yaml, json
from pathlib import Path

router = APIRouter(prefix="/views", tags=["views"])

@router.get("/needs-attention")
def needs_attention():
    # Invoke task 11's script, parse needs-attention.md
    subprocess.run(["python", str(Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "scripts" / "generate_needs_attention.py")], check=True)
    with open(Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "needs-attention.md") as f:
        content = f.read()
    # Parse markdown → return structured JSON (or just return raw markdown)
    return {"markdown": content}  # Frontend can render markdown

@router.get("/blockers")
def blockers():
    with open(Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "projects.yaml") as f:
        projects = yaml.safe_load(f)["projects"]
    blocked = []
    for p in [p for p in projects if p["status"] == "active"]:
        tasks_json = subprocess.run(["task-master", "list", "--json"], cwd=p["path"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
        tasks = json.loads(tasks_json) if tasks_json else []
        for t in tasks:
            if t.get("status") == "blocked":
                blocked.append({"project": p["name"], "task": t})
    return {"blockers": blocked}
```

tasks.description: Add new task or fix to a project via API, calling task-master add under the hood.
tasks.details:
Extend `backend/app/routes/projects.py`:
```python
from pydantic import BaseModel

class TaskCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str
    description: str = ""
    priority: str = "medium"
    parent_id: int = None  # for fixes

@router.post("/{name}/tasks")
def add_task(name: str, task: TaskCreate):
    with open(Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "projects.yaml") as f:
        projects = yaml.safe_load(f)["projects"]
    project = next((p for p in projects if p["name"] == name), None)
    if not project:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Project not found")
    
    cmd = ["task-master", "add", task.title, "--description", task.description, "--priority", task.priority]
    if task.parent_id:
        cmd += ["--parent", str(task.parent_id)]
    
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=project["path"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    return {"message": "Task added", "output": result.stdout}
```
Handle errors (task-master failures) with try/except.

```python
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPBasic, HTTPBasicCredentials
import os, secrets

security = HTTPBasic()

def verify_auth(credentials: HTTPBasicCredentials = Depends(security)):
    user = os.getenv("KIRA_HQ_USER", "mariusz")
```

Create `scripts/weekly_review.py`:
```python
import datetime, yaml, json, glob
from pathlib import Path

def weekly_review():
    week = datetime.date.today().isocalendar()[1]
    year = datetime.date.today().year
    
    with open(Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "projects.yaml") as f:
        projects = yaml.safe_load(f)["projects"]
    
    review = f"# Weekly Review {year}-W{week:02d}\n\n"
    
    # Tasks completed this week per project
    review += "## Tasks Completed\n"
    for p in projects:
        # Count done tasks from last 7 days in tasks.json
        # (requires task-master to expose completed_at timestamps)
        review += f"- {p['name']}: X tasks\n"
    
    # Tokens (sum last 7 daily files)
    review += "\n## Token Usage\n"
    token_files = sorted(glob.glob(str(Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "metrics" / "tokens-*.json")))[-7:]
    totals = {}
    for f in token_files:
        with open(f) as tf:
            daily = json.load(tf)
            for proj, counts in daily.items():
                if proj not in totals: totals[proj] = 0
                totals[proj] += counts["in"] + counts["out"]
    top3 = sorted(totals.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:3]
    for proj, count in top3:
        review += f"- {proj}: {count:,} tokens\n"
    
    # Cron success rate (from pipeline.log)
    # Snapshot health (check last 7 days)
    # Parallel track comparison (if in Faza 2 period)
    
    outpath = Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "reviews" / f"{year}-W{week:02d}.md"
    with open(outpath, "w") as out:
        out.write(review)
    
    print(f"✅ Weekly review written to {outpath}")
    # Stub: send to Telegram (real impl in Faza 4)
```
Schedule cron: Saturday 09:00.

```python
def handle_unstale(chat_id, project_name):
    with open(Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "projects.yaml") as f:
        projects_yaml = yaml.safe_load(f)
    
    project = next((p for p in projects_yaml["projects"] if p["name"] == project_name), None)
    if not project:
        return f"❌ Project '{project_name}' not found"
    if project["status"] != "stale":
        return f"⚠️  Project '{project_name}' is not stale (current: {project['status']})"
    
    project["status"] = "active"
    with open(Path.home() / ".kira-hq" / "projects.yaml", "w") as f:
        yaml.dump(projects_yaml, f)
    
    return f"✅ Project '{project_name}' is now active"
```

```markdown
Command center for managing 10–15 AI-driven projects in parallel.
```
